title: Re-reads connectionState.fromHandle?.id instead of the already-captured non-null fromHandle local
description: Inside the edge-drop branch, the insertEdgeJoinNode call passes `sourceHandle: connectionState.fromHandle?.id ?? null`. The local `fromHandle` (captured on line 219 as `connectionState.fromHandle`) is the same object, and its source type was just verified on line 289 (`if (fromHandle?.type !== 'source') return`), so `fromHandle` is guaranteed non-null here. The sibling source-to-source and node-to-node branches already use the captured local (e.g. lines 259, 283 use `fromHandle.id ?? null` / `toHandle.id ?? null`). Using `fromHandle.id ?? null` here removes the redundant optional-chain re-dereference and keeps the branch consistent with its siblings.
est_reduction: 1 line edited (no net line change); removes a redundant property re-read
behavior_preservation: Identical: connectionState.fromHandle and the fromHandle local reference the same object, and fromHandle is non-null past the line 289 guard, so `fromHandle.id ?? null` evaluates to exactly the same value.
